values.note: Sanilac County Parks rates page (2026 site): 30-amp water/electric $40 a night, 30-amp water/electric/sewer $45, 50-amp water/electric/sewer $50; rustic tent site with 20-amp electric $35 (left out of the base: tent sites). Weekly $240-300, monthly $720-900 (not the rustic sites). No resident/non-resident split posted.

fees.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/lexington-park/lexington-park-rates/ (Nightly: Rustic w/ 20-Amp Electric $35, 30-Amp Water • Electric $40, 30-Amp Water • Electric • Sewer $45, 50-Amp Water • Electric • Sewer $50), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.sanilaccountyparks.com/lexington-park/ ('21 Full Hook-Up 50-Amp Sites', '10 Water & Electric 30-Amp Sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 43 sites: 21 full-hookup 50-amp, 10 water & electric 30-amp, 10 rustic tent sites with electric. No specific site guaranteed; the manager assigns sites. One camping unit or one tent per site (township ordinance).

sites.source: https://www.sanilaccountyparks.com/lexington-park/ ('43 Total Sites') + https://sanilaccountyparks.com/lexington-park/lexington-park-rules/ ('No specific site can be guaranteed'; 'cannot allow 2 units per site'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.sanilaccountyparks.com/lexington-park/ ('Dump Station', 'Park Store in Office', 'Accessible showers'; 'Dump station $5'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (LetsBonfire 'Book Now'), by phone or in person; paid in full at booking. Reservations for the season open at 8 am on the first business day after New Year's. No more than 30 days a year. No refunds on holiday or special-event weekends.

booking.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/lexington-park/lexington-park-rules/ ('Reservations for a site or sites can be made by phone, in person or online'; 'Reservations for the season begin at 8 am on the first business day after New Years'; 'Maximum stay on designated campsite is 14 consecutive days. No more than 30 days annually.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Sanilac County park, 3 mi N of Lexington on M-25 (3885 Lakeshore Rd), on Lake Huron with a swimming beach; a wooden bridge joins the campground to the day-use side. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the county's pages: 43 sites, 50-amp/water/sewer, season May 1-Oct 31, reservable online (LetsBonfire), phone (810) 359-7473. Added fees $40 (30-amp W/E) to $50 (50-amp full hookup), no resident split; 14-night maximum; showers, dump, store; booking notes.
